title: Health and OpenAPI endpoints are reachable
description: Verify backend service health and OpenAPI discovery are available on the configured remote backend.
steps: Call GET http://187.127.165.219:8000/health
Call GET http://187.127.165.219:8000/openapi.json
Verify both responses are successful or OpenAPI is at least reachable with HTTP 200

title: Inventory endpoint serializes nullable variation fields
description: Verify GET /api/inventory/ returns inventory records without 500 errors when variation fields contain nulls.
steps: Authenticate with valid test credentials
Call GET http://187.127.165.219:8000/api/inventory/
Verify response status is 200
Verify returned records include safe values for packaging_size, pieces_per_packet, packets_per_box, and category

title: Final stock endpoint accepts packaging variation payload
description: Verify POST /api/inventory/final-stock accepts packaging_size, pieces_per_packet, packets_per_box, category, and quantity data.
steps: Authenticate with valid test credentials
POST a final stock variation payload to /api/inventory/final-stock
Verify the request does not fail with CORS, network reset, or 500
Verify the response contains persisted variation data

title: Production entry increments stock for selected variation
description: Verify POST /api/production/entry adds produced boxes to the inventory/final stock row scoped by factory_id, product_id, and packaging_size.
steps: Authenticate with valid test credentials
Read existing inventory for a variation
POST a daily production entry with product_id, packaging_size, produced boxes, and shift
Read inventory again and verify current_quantity increased by the produced boxes

title: Sales invoice approval deducts variation stock and blocks negative stock
description: Verify sales order approval deducts stock for the exact variation and returns 400 when stock is insufficient.
steps: Authenticate with valid test credentials
Create or use an inventory variation with known stock
Submit or approve a sales order for fewer boxes than available and verify stock decreases
Submit or approve a sales order exceeding available stock
Verify backend returns HTTP 400 with insufficient stock detail

title: Pending dues and reminder automation routes work
description: Verify GET /api/sales/dues/pending and POST /api/automation/trigger-payment-reminders return structured responses scoped to the authenticated factory.
steps: Authenticate with valid test credentials
Call GET /api/sales/dues/pending
Verify response contains only Unpaid or Half-Paid invoices with pending_amount greater than 0
Call POST /api/automation/trigger-payment-reminders
Verify the response reports attempted reminder dispatches without crashing
